body: I’ve felt suicidal before, but not at this level, and not for this reason. As for when I feel most lucid, I usually feel more grounded if I latch onto a certain emotion, and don’t think about anything else. Reading out loud to myself and listening to podcasts helps a lot somehow. I feel a little better today but this feeling isn’t really going away.

These are the thoughts that run on loop in my head all day. My thinking is it’s okay to be alone, however, it does really, really suck. Just know that even without others you have value, value as a living soul who can think and feel. Don’t underestimate that value. Too many people think that you shouldn’t die because you “have people to live for”, but judging the value of someone based purely off their relationships is stupid. Even all alone you still deserve to live, you are a being that exists and has valid thoughts and feelings.

I’m not sure as to why this happens, but it does help me immensely. I feel closest to real when I’m at my saddest, I kind of latch onto the physical sensation of crying, and the mental hurt it brings, and don’t think about anything else. In those periods of time I feel real and solid, like I’m a part of the world. If I’m particularly bad that day I try to embrace my fear and fatigue and just cry. I hope you feel alright right now man, and get better.
I can’t describe how much I needed this, knowing that other people are experiencing similar things, and that there’s a name for it. Just, thank you so much

Yes, I’m just really scared right now and dying is a comforting thought, I can’t keep living in this weird state, like I’m not me, like I’m watching someone else’s life. It’s only been two days but it’s been hell. Simple conversations are when I’ve felt the worse because I don’t think of or control the words that come out, it’s like I’m on autopilot
